title: Qualify a donor-paired within-peritoneum test after the Finnish control result
question: Can published pathology recover the missing control or can an independent lesion versus case-peritoneum experiment withstand a physical scan audit?
scope: Public metadata, protocols, array feature annotations and bounded CEL header ranges. No new expression outcomes, full CEL files, restricted sources, paid compute or contact. Preserve the five frozen genes and their signs.
steps: Reconcile the independent catalogue and Finnish primary sampling documentation with the previous candidate audit.

Verify linked Erlangen donor pairs, physical chip, scanner, day, order and feature coverage without reading intensities. Check whether public pathology documents negative comparison tissue and subsites.
Publish a frozen, narrower procedure if identifiable. If complete scan confounding or missing pathology defeats a contrast, quantify the obstacle and qualify an alternative from existing metadata.
deliverables: Source-linked report and decisions by scientific question
Reproducible metadata audits with aggregate evidence and regression tests
acceptance: Keep donor disease status, biopsy pathology, local versus distant tissue and technical overlap distinct.
Count unique donors, shared technical strata and paired directions of scan order. Distinguish assay signal identifiability from histological specificity.
Reconcile all five targets by the established annotation rule, distinguish new from reused material and commit any follow-up before targeted outcomes.
Publish only aggregates and original code, check tests and record sources, caps and limitations.
